steps:
mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
libdir={prefix}/lib
includedir={prefix}/include

Name: gsm
Description: GSM 06.10 lossy speech compression
Version: 1.0.22
Libs: -L{prefix}/lib -lgsm
Cflags: -I{prefix}/include
' > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/gsm.pc

mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
libdir={prefix}/lib
includedir={prefix}/include

Name: quirc
Description: QR decoder library
Version: 1.2
Libs: -L{prefix}/lib -lquirc
Cflags: -I{prefix}/include
' > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/quirc.pc

mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
includedir={prefix}/include

Name: SPIRV-Headers
Description: Khronos SPIR-V headers
Version: 1.4.357.0
Cflags: -I{prefix}/include
' > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/spirv-headers.pc

libcaca.prefixup: sed -i 's/^bin_PROGRAMS =.*/bin_PROGRAMS =/' src/Makefile.am && sed -i 's/^noinst_PROGRAMS =.*/noinst_PROGRAMS =/' src/Makefile.am && sed -i 's/^noinst_PROGRAMS =.*/noinst_PROGRAMS =/' examples/Makefile.am

steps:
mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
libdir={prefix}/lib
includedir={prefix}/include

Name: amf
Description: AMD Advanced Media Framework headers
Version: 1.5.2
Cflags: -I{prefix}/include
' > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/amf.pc

mkdir -p {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig && printf 'prefix={prefix}
libdir={prefix}/lib
includedir={prefix}/include

Name: ladspa
Description: Linux Audio Developer Simple Plugin API
Version: 1.17
Cflags: -I{prefix}/include
' > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/ladspa.pc

printf 'prefix=%s
exec_prefix=${{prefix}}
libdir=${{prefix}}/lib
includedir=${{prefix}}/include

Name: rav1e
Description: The fastest and safest AV1 encoder
Version: 0.8.1
Libs: -L${{libdir}} -lrav1e
Libs.private: -lm -lpthread -ldl
Cflags: -I${{includedir}}/rav1e
' "{prefix}" > {prefix}/lib/pkgconfig/rav1e.pc
make -C {src}/librtmp install prefix={prefix} CRYPTO= OPT="-O2 -I{prefix}/include" XLDFLAGS="-L{prefix}/lib"
sed -i "s/latin-1/utf-8/g" {src}/waflib/*.py && cd {src} && python3 waf configure --prefix={prefix} --autostart=none && python3 waf build -j{jobs} && python3 waf install
